description.value: Mazaj Best Donair is a Middle Eastern restaurant in Langley specializing in donairs, a beloved street-food staple in BC. Located in a strip-mall unit on 210 Street, it offers the kind of hearty, affordable fare that hungry touring cyclists gravitate toward after a long day in the saddle.
